args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Incident opened to track investigation of the v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Both actions completed successfully. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api was failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions.

**Investigation findings:**
- Current version: **v2.3.1** — **unhealthy** in production (error rate 0.18)
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release
- Most recent healthy production release: **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older)

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — status verified as `rolled_out`.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api, describing the rollback and noting the v2.3.1 regression for follow-up investigation. The on-call engineer has been paged.

The service is now back on the most recent release that was healthy in production.
